scope: Native, graphics and CPU operation/case schema admission for independent release only
claim: No qualification or operation status upgrade; preserve failed attempts and fail unknown when evidence or host inspection is unavailable. No runtime launch, signal, cleanup or deletion.
cpu_extension: Bind exact CPU request/descriptor/candidate/pack/case refs and selected fixture digest; preserve unsupported or failed operation status without qualification upgrade.
schema_admission: Require exact integer schema_version 1 for operation, plan, request and every new native/graphics/CPU control record. CPU descriptor and candidate base also require exact integer version 1; absent, other and boolean versions are rejected. Original translated-graphics case format remains explicitly versionless.
